selection: full-horizon official VAL overall minFDE6, strict improvement; final from original NLL
phase_transition: own warmup best model + AdamW + RNG; LR only changed; NLL sampler reset as frozen Stage3B
tiny_selection: TRAIN only, three classes plus moving/low-motion history V/P; full context
bin_convention: [lo,hi); offline future endpoint displacement; <5 and >5 strictly as frozen definitions

bootstrap.weighting: actor-window deltas pooled within resampled complete clusters

scientific_rule.SUPPORTED: Overall delta<0 and CI upper<0; no reliable Vehicle/Pedestrian harm; >=1 important motion group reliably improves; no collapse
scientific_rule.PARTIAL: Overall CI spans0; >=2 important motion groups reliably improve; no reliable Vehicle/Pedestrian harm; no collapse
scientific_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: reliable Overall or Vehicle/Pedestrian harm, no reliable important motion gain, or remaining support criteria unmet
scientific_rule.major_reliable_harm_guard: conservative: any Vehicle/Pedestrian FDE CI lower>0; no effect-size threshold invented

router_collapse: same expert gets >0.9 probability in >95% of all current-valid actor-windows

expert_functional_collapse.population: all current-valid actor-window, all6 modes evaluated on same hidden
expert_functional_collapse.rule: both experts numerically zero OR >95% actor-windows have relative RMS difference<1e-3 and mean cosine>0.999
expert_functional_collapse.purpose: descriptive numerical near-identity criterion declared before training; not a tuning objective

efficiency.timing: CUDA events, synchronized model forward only; preloaded GPU batch
